prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-28, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-04-28):
Fiscal period 2026 Q2 (filed 2026-04-28). Revenue 9,532M, gross margin 20%, operating income 777M (operating margin 8%), net income 511M, diluted EPS 0.45. Total assets 30,558M, total liabilities 39,015M, shareholders' equity -8,465M. Current assets 10,559M vs current liabilities 11,449M (current ratio 0.92), retained earnings -8,881M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The reported balance sheet shows negative book equity (-8.5 B), negative retained earnings (-8.9 B), and liabilities exceeding assets, indicating technical insolvency and a high probability of default. While recent operating results are modestly positive, the capital structure and liquidity metrics (current ratio 0.92) dominate credit assessment and place the issuer deep in the distressed segment of the ratings scale.
DECISION: CC
